name: Kinosaki Nanase
source: The daughter of the school's principal, [url=/c14452]Kenjirou's[/url] cousin and a second-year student. She is an honors student who is trusted by the teachers, and is also very serious. Due to her appearance and status she has an unapproachable aura.
